title: tree-sitter 0.25.10 → 0.27.0 in the osf crate
summary: A dependency-only change: the `osf` crate pins `tree-sitter` to 0.27.0 instead of 0.25.10, and Cargo.lock follows, dropping the transitive `regex-syntax` edge that 0.25.x pulled in. No source file changes, so the runtime shape of the system is untouched — what moves is the parser runtime that every Rust source file in a scanned repository is fed through, and the lockfile graph underneath it.
